terms.p: Encoding what stage a value is at in its type, so that calling a method too early or in the wrong order is a compile error rather than a runtime bug.

terms.x: the platform you are building for
terms.p: The string naming an architecture, operating system and ABI, such as thumbv7em-none-eabihf, where none means there is no operating system.
The single function a program without the standard library must provide to say what happens when code panics, since there is no default.
The one type a program nominates to serve every heap allocation, which a program without an operating system has to supply itself.
A stretch of code during which interrupts are disabled, so that shared data cannot be modified halfway through by a handler.
